_about: Cut-offs and tiers for grade.ts, tuned 2026-10-01 on dev sets and checked on holdout sets with Typed Decisions. Re-tune when the model package or any question wording changes. Report: scripts/eval_results/2026-10-01-cutoffs-report.md

tiers.signal: yes/no: noul >= cutoff counts as true (holdout AUC >= 0.90, beat baseline on English)
tiers.weight: use the probability as a weight; no yes/no cut-off (ranks well, cut-off did not transfer)
tiers.display: show only; do not feed the grade until reworked

routing._thai_script: Replies containing Thai script go to Pat for review: on this English-tokenizer model Thai scores bunch around 0.3-0.55 whatever the reply says.
routing._name_only_account: An account with no industry and no tags is not sent for a fit judgment.

fit._cutoff: Highest fit Noul >= cutoff is the fit, else no_fit. Chosen with Pat: catches a Thai jay kitchen and a supermarket chain that 0.35 missed. 41/46 across dev and relabelled holdout.

buyer_response._note: Use the probabilities, not the pick (holdout AUC 0.87 / 0.89 / 0.87; pick 11/26).
